placement.title: Cross-agent capability discovery and skills
placement.rationale: Distinct work package, not a redefinition of numerical matrix/vector C02; M2 qualification remains immutable.

work_package.title: Cross-agent capability discovery and skills
work_package.path_policy: Only deliberately selected agent-facing functions are skill-published; ordinary .NET helpers remain internal to the audit. No dependency on Decision or AURA.

chunks.title: Portable Discovery protocol and introspected seed
chunks.deliverables: Package dw.tools.math.discovery with explicit opt-in exposure, canonical CLR binding fingerprints, portable dw.discovery draft-1 schema validation, and independently qualified Math seed.
chunks.acceptance: All 13 pinned Decision fixtures produce identical expected acceptance decisions; no public helpers or Documented-only APIs leak; 3 selected Math static methods resolve by exact CLR signatures and compiled examples.
chunks.boundary_acceptance: Do not infer BrokerReady, serializable request DTOs, AURA permission, native provider availability or cross-repository interoperability from copying files; do not mutate stable M2/M3 contracts just to attach attributes.
chunks.readiness: planned; requires topology rebaseline and exact staged files/commands before DWF ready
chunks.refinement: Proposed cross-repository compatibility contract only; neither success nor product capability is claimed.
